svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Select the neighborhood or area in which to look for a house. → Identify which housing web
sites are the most popular or most used in the target area by searching with location keyw
ords.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Check housing websites to see in which neighborhoods the listings that fit my budget and r
equirements are clustered, as one way to choose the area. → Select the neighborhood or are
a in which to look for a house.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Ask people who live in the target country for recommendations of places to look at. → Sele
ct the neighborhood or area in which to look for a house.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Pick a neighborhood close to the place I regularly go to, such as a specific job or colleg
e. → Select the neighborhood or area in which to look for a house.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Draw an area on the map to define the search area, instead of searching only by neighborho
od name. → Select the neighborhood or area in which to look for a house.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Filter the listings by price range, size or bedroom count and home type, and by extra crit
eria such as move-in date, pets and utilities. → Narrow the remaining options further with
lower-priority criteria such as amenities, extra features and how good the place looks.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Narrow the remaining options further with lower-priority criteria such as amenities, extra
features and how good the place looks. → Contact the people offering the shortlisted plac
es after the options have been narrowed down.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Contact the provider through other channels such as their own website, phone or email when
they do not respond in the app. → Carry out the communication with providers outside the
housing apps, keeping those apps mainly as a way to discover places.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Start searching and use the site's full functionality without registering or logging in. →
Avoid long processes with buttons whose outcome I cannot predict, preferring sites that k
eep the options minimal and list what can be done.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See what happens after contacting a provider, including whether and when they will reply a
nd what to expect if the contact fails. → Carry out all housing communication with provide
rs in one place on the website.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Contact the people offering the shortlisted places after the options have been narrowed do
wn. → Share my personal information only after both sides have confirmed availability and
interest.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Filter the listings by price range, size or bedroom count and home type, and by extra crit
eria such as move-in date, pets and utilities. → Get an overview of the available options
and their price ranges in the new area.
